outcomes: return over the next 21 trading days
realized volatility of the next 21 trading days
universe: S&P 500 with index-join dates, 2010-01-01 to 2021-12-31 (later data held back)
tests: stock-specific features: within-sector rank IC; market-state features (vix_pct, vix_slope): time-series rank correlation with the equal-weight market outcome
